subject: Datadog GovCloud: security scoping & procurement kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@datadoghq.com>, procurement@datadoghq.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog GovCloud: security scoping & procurement kickoff

Hi Alice / Datadog procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation at Observability Connect — excited about moving Redwood Inference into a GovCloud-compatible partner track with Datadog. Our legal and security teams are aligning on procurement and a security scoping call to make sure the GovCloud deployment and the marketplace listing meet both organizations' requirements.

High-level asks for the kickoff: 
- 60-minute security scoping meeting (FedRAMP / IL/US requirements overlap)
- Inventory of required artifacts (SOC2, pen test summary, encryption & key management notes)
- Marketplace procurement steps and expected timeline for contract negotiation

We have a preliminary checklist and a partial RFI attached for your team's intake. Can we get a meeting on the books next week? My availability: Mon/Tue (AEST-friendly windows), Wed/Thu mornings (PDT).

Attachments: RDW-Datadog-GovCloud-Checklist.pdf, RFI-Rhythm-Answers.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@datadoghq.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: GovCloud Security <govcloud-security@datadoghq.com>, procurement@datadoghq.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog GovCloud: security scoping & procurement kickoff

Hi Ben — great to hear from you and thanks for the materials. We reviewed the checklist briefly and this is the right next step.

Proposed plan:
- Kickoff call with our GovCloud security engineering and procurement on Tue 2026-08-18 at 10:00 AM PDT (I know that overlaps with your Wed morning window; please confirm).
- We will bring: lead security engineer (Chris Park), marketplace onboarding PM (Rina Shah), and a procurement rep to outline contract milestones.
- Pre-call ask: please add the expected deployment topology (VPC peering vs private link), and whether you plan to use Redwood Private or Dedicated for GovCloud. If you can drop that into the shared Drive doc we can pre-stage questions.

I've looped in GovCloud Security. If Tuesday doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll iterate.

Best,
Alice
Alice Martin
Partner Solutions — Datadog
alice.martin@datadoghq.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@datadoghq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog GovCloud: security scoping & procurement kickoff

Alice — Tue 8/18 10:00 AM PDT works for our core team. Confirmed attendees on our side: myself, Marissa (partnership lead), Jonas (product engineer — runtime & networking), and Laura (procurement & contracts).

Quick answers to the pre-call asks:
- Planned deployment: we intend to offer Redwood Private (customer VPC deployment) for the initial GovCloud customers, with Private control plane and optional on-prem agents. We will evaluate Private vs Dedicated after initial integrations.
- VPC connectivity: default plan is PrivateLink peering; some customers may request site-to-site VPN for air-gapped setups — we've flagged those as exceptions.

I've uploaded a short topology diagram and updated the Drive note: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/datadog/govcloud-scoping-note

Agenda suggestion for the call (30–45 min):
1) Introductions & scope (5)
2) Deployment architectures we support (10)
3) Artifact review: SOC2, pen test, KMS/HSM notes (10)
4) Procurement milestones for marketplace listing and contract timeline (10)
5) Action items & owners (5)

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 06:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Datadog GovCloud kick prep

Team — quick prep checklist ahead of the 10:00 AM call (I’ll join live):
- Jonas: bring a 2-slide export of the Private deployment topology (KMS integration, network ports, default auth flows).
- Laura: have our procurement playbook summary and the Redwood standard SOW redlines ready.
- Ben: share customer-facing marketplace SKU options and expected billing model (usage vs reserved).
- Action: consolidate artifacts in the shared Drive folder and mark items we cannot surface publicly (we’ll note those as secured attachments post-call).

I attached the partial RFI answers we already have — please add gaps. We should aim to have the full artifact bundle ready to send to govcloud-security@datadoghq.com within 48 hours of the call.

Attachments: RFI-Rhythm-Answers.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: GovCloud Security <govcloud-security@datadoghq.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Martin <alice.martin@datadoghq.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@datadoghq.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog GovCloud: security scoping & procurement kickoff

Ben / Marissa — thanks for the call earlier this week. Quick recap and requested artifacts follow-up.

Recap (short):
- Datadog will own the GovCloud marketplace on-boarding and audit requirements; Redwood will supply deployment architecture and artifact bundle for security review.
- Primary points: KMS/HSM integration, key rotation policy, network model (PrivateLink + VPN exceptions), and encryption-in-transit/client certs.

Requested artifacts (please share as a single package):
1) SOC2 report (latest) — redacted where necessary
2) Penetration test executive summary
3) KMS architecture diagram and key custody notes (HSM vendor if any)
4) Data residency statement for GovCloud customers and data retention policy
5) Contact for compliance escalation (name, phone, email)

Please upload to the shared Drive link or send to govcloud-security@datadoghq.com securely. We have a preliminary timeline: artifact intake by 2026-08-23, internal review complete by 2026-09-03, and marketplace notice by mid-September assuming no open issues.

Best regards,
Chris Park
Security Engineering — Datadog GovCloud
govcloud-security@datadoghq.com
